About

Good data means nothing if no one understands it.

I'm a Data Analyst focused on turning data into clear and actionable insights through structured analysis and thoughtful dashboard design.

I help teams and clients better understand their data by focusing not only on numbers, but on the story and decisions behind them. Through careful data cleaning, structured analysis, and clean dashboard layouts, I aim to make complex data straightforward to explore and act upon.

I have completed practical projects using Excel, Power Query, Power BI, DAX, and SQL, and I continuously refine my approach to deliver analysis that is both technically sound and easy for decision-makers to use.

If you have a Data-related project or an opportunity to collaborate, feel free to reach out.
